title: Minecraft: Java Edition System Requirements
author: Sophie Austin
imageAltText: Minecraft characters traverse a torchlit cave filled with sulfur spikes and sulfur cubes.
description: Minecraft: Java Edition is over 17 years old now, and it’s grown a lot over the years! Worlds are bigger and the game has continued to evolve with new features, technical improvements, and more. But like a teenager outgrowing their shoes – Java Edition needs room to keep growing, too. That’s why we’re updating the minimum and recommended system requirements: to help players understand what kind of setup Java Edition needs to run at its best today.

blocks.source_text: Minecraft: Java Edition is over 17 years old now, and it’s grown a lot over the years! Worlds are bigger and the game has continued to evolve with new features, technical improvements, and more. But like a teenager outgrowing their shoes – Java Edition needs room to keep growing, too. That’s why we’re updating the minimum and recommended system requirements: to help players understand what kind of setup Java Edition needs to run at its best today.
blocks.translated_text: 《Minecraft: Java版》如今已经问世超过17年了，这些年来它发生了很大的变化！游戏世界的规模变得更大了，游戏本身也通过新功能、技术改进等方式不断进化。但就像一个长身体的青少年需要更大的空间一样，《Java版》也需要更多的发展空间。因此，我们正在更新游戏的最低系统要求和推荐系统要求，以帮助玩家了解如今运行《Java版》所需的配置环境。

blocks.source_text: What’s changing?
blocks.translated_text: 有哪些变化呢？

blocks.source_text: The previous system requirements for Minecraft: Java Edition were based on older hardware and older graphics technology. While those specs may have reflected what Minecraft needed in the past, they no longer represent what the game needs to run well today.
blocks.translated_text: 之前的《Minecraft: Java版》系统要求是基于较旧的硬件和图形技术制定的。虽然这些规格在过去可能满足了游戏的需求，但现在已经无法满足游戏当前运行的要求了。

blocks.source_text: This is why we’re raising both the minimum and recommended system requirements for Minecraft: Java Edition. The new requirements include more memory, more powerful processors, and graphics hardware that supports Vulkan 1.3.
blocks.translated_text: 这就是为什么我们要提高 Minecraft: Java 版的最低系统要求和推荐系统要求的原因。新的要求包括更多的内存、更强大的处理器，以及支持 Vulkan 1.3 的图形硬件。

blocks.source_text: For minimum requirements, the new target is 1080p at 30 FPS using the Fast preset. This means a 64-bit system, 8 GB of RAM with a discrete GPU or 12 GB with integrated graphics, a 4-core processor, and a Vulkan 1.3 capable GPU with at least 2 GB of VRAM.
blocks.translated_text: 在最低系统要求方面，新的目标是使用“Fast”预设设置时能够实现 1080p 分辨率和 30 帧每秒的帧率。这意味着需要一台 64 位系统、8 GB 的 RAM（搭配独立显卡）或 12 GB 的 RAM（搭配集成显卡）、一个 4 核处理器，以及一个支持 Vulkan 1.3 且至少拥有 2 GB VRAM 的显卡。

blocks.source_text: For recommended requirements, the new target is 1080p at 60 FPS using the Fancy preset. This includes 16 GB of RAM, a stronger modern processor, and a more capable graphics card with 6 GB of VRAM.
blocks.translated_text: 在推荐系统要求方面，新的目标是使用“Fancy”预设设置时能够实现 1080p 分辨率和 60 帧每秒的帧率。这需要 16 GB 的 RAM、一个更先进的现代处理器，以及一块拥有 6 GB VRAM 的性能更强的显卡。

blocks.source_text: Compared with many modern AAA games, these updated requirements are still relatively low. Java Edition does not require a high-end gaming PC or a cutting-edge graphics card to play. The new specs are simply a clearer baseline for how to ensure a stable Minecraft experience today, especially at 1080p.
blocks.translated_text: 与许多现代的 AAA 级游戏相比，这些更新后的系统要求仍然相对较低。Java版不需要高端游戏电脑或最先进的显卡就能运行。新的系统要求只是为了更明确地界定当前环境下如何确保 Minecraft 的稳定体验，尤其是在 1080p 分辨率下。

blocks.source_text: Why we are updating the requirements
blocks.translated_text: 我们为什么要更新这些系统要求？

blocks.source_text: Our goal is simple: we want to make it clear for players what kind of computer can run Java Edition smoothly. While older devices may still launch the game, they will struggle to deliver a good experience. This can lead to low frame rates, visual issues, long loading times, or performance that doesn’t match what players expect.
blocks.translated_text: 我们的目标很简单：我们希望让玩家清楚地知道什么样的电脑能够流畅运行 Java版。虽然旧设备可能仍能启动游戏，但它们很难提供良好的游戏体验。这可能导致帧率低、视觉问题、加载时间长，或者游戏性能达不到玩家的预期。

blocks.source_text: Updating the requirements also helps us keep improving Minecraft. Supporting hardware that no longer runs the game well can limit what we’re able to modernize behind the scenes. By setting clearer recommendations, we can focus on making Java Edition better for our players.
blocks.translated_text: 更新系统要求也有助于我们不断改进《我的世界》。如果某些硬件不再能够流畅运行游戏，那么我们将无法对游戏进行现代化改造。通过设定更明确的建议，我们可以专注于让Java版为玩家提供更好的体验。

blocks.source_text: Will this stop me from playing?
blocks.translated_text: 这会阻止我玩游戏吗？

blocks.source_text: Some players using older hardware may notice that their device is now listed below the minimum spec. This may include older graphics cards, some older integrated graphics options, and older Intel-based Mac devices.
blocks.translated_text: 一些使用老旧硬件的玩家可能会发现他们的设备被列入了最低配置要求清单之下。这些设备可能包括较旧的显卡、某些旧款集成显卡选项，以及基于Intel的旧款Mac设备。

blocks.source_text: These updated recommended system requirements won’t stop you from playing Minecraft: Java Edition today. If your computer falls below the new minimum requirements, Java Edition should still launch. However, its performance and visual quality are no longer guaranteed on below-spec hardware, and it may struggle or fail to launch Java Edition in the future – especially as we transition away from OpenGL and towards Vulkan. We will keep players informed of these changes, especially changes that will sunset hardware that previously supported Minecraft: Java Edition.
blocks.translated_text: 这些更新的推荐系统要求并不会阻止您今天就开始玩《Minecraft: Java版》。即使您的计算机配置低于新的最低要求，Java版仍应该可以启动。但是，在配置较低的硬件上，游戏的性能和视觉效果将不再得到保障，未来游戏可能会出现运行困难或无法启动的情况——尤其是在我们逐步淘汰OpenGL、转向Vulkan技术的过程中。我们会及时通知玩家这些变化，特别是那些会导致 previously supported (先前支持) 的硬件不再兼容《Minecraft: Java版》的变化。

blocks.source_text: What should I do?
blocks.translated_text: 我该怎么办？

blocks.source_text: From July 21, check the [Java System Requirements page](https://www.minecraft.net/store/minecraft-java-bedrock-edition-pc?tabs=%7B%22details%22%3A1%7D) on Minecraft.net for the updated minimum and recommended specs. If you already play Java Edition without issues, you may not notice anything changing right away. If your game often struggles, the new requirements may help explain why and give you a clearer target for a smoother experience.
blocks.translated_text: 从7月21日起，请访问 Minecraft.net 上的[Java系统要求页面](https://www.minecraft.net/store/minecraft-java-bedrock-edition-pc?tabs=%7B%22details%22%3A1%7D)查看更新后的最低配置和推荐配置。如果您已经在使用Java版且没有遇到问题，可能不会立即感觉到任何变化；但如果游戏经常出现卡顿或延迟，新的系统要求或许能帮助您找出原因，并为您提供更清晰的改进方向，从而获得更加流畅的游戏体验。

blocks.source_text: If you’re buying a new device or checking whether your current one is ready for Java Edition, use the new recommended specs as your best guide. They are designed around a stronger, steadier experience at 1080p and 60 FPS using the Fancy preset.
blocks.translated_text: 如果您正在购买新设备，或者想确认当前设备是否适合运行Java版，请以新的推荐配置作为参考。这些配置旨在确保在1080p分辨率和60帧每秒的刷新率下，玩家能够获得更稳定、更顺畅的游戏体验（使用“Fancy”预设设置）。

blocks.source_text: The recommended system requirements change on July 21
blocks.translated_text: 新的推荐系统要求将于7月21日生效。

blocks.source_text: Performance and visual quality are no longer guaranteed on hardware below the new minimum
blocks.translated_text: 对于低于新最低配置要求的硬件设备，游戏性能和视觉效果将不再得到保证。

blocks.source_text: The updated minimum target is 1080p at 30 FPS on Fast settings
blocks.translated_text: 更新后的最低配置要求为：在“Fast”设置下，分辨率为1080p，帧率为30 FPS

blocks.source_text: The updated recommended target is 1080p at 60 FPS on Fancy settings
blocks.translated_text: 更新后的推荐配置要求为：在“Fancy”设置下，分辨率为1080p，帧率为60 FPS

content:
Minecraft: Java Edition is over 17 years old now, and it’s grown a lot over the years! Worlds are bigger and the game has continued to evolve with new features, technical improvements, and more. But like a teenager outgrowing their shoes – Java Edition needs room to keep growing, too. That’s why we’re updating the minimum and recommended system requirements: to help players understand what kind of setup Java Edition needs to run at its best today.

What’s changing?

The previous system requirements for Minecraft: Java Edition were based on older hardware and older graphics technology. While those specs may have reflected what Minecraft needed in the past, they no longer represent what the game needs to run well today.

This is why we’re raising both the minimum and recommended system requirements for Minecraft: Java Edition. The new requirements include more memory, more powerful processors, and graphics hardware that supports Vulkan 1.3.

For minimum requirements, the new target is 1080p at 30 FPS using the Fast preset. This means a 64-bit system, 8 GB of RAM with a discrete GPU or 12 GB with integrated graphics, a 4-core processor, and a Vulkan 1.3 capable GPU with at least 2 GB of VRAM.

For recommended requirements, the new target is 1080p at 60 FPS using the Fancy preset. This includes 16 GB of RAM, a stronger modern processor, and a more capable graphics card with 6 GB of VRAM.

Compared with many modern AAA games, these updated requirements are still relatively low. Java Edition does not require a high-end gaming PC or a cutting-edge graphics card to play. The new specs are simply a clearer baseline for how to ensure a stable Minecraft experience today, especially at 1080p.

Why we are updating the requirements

Our goal is simple: we want to make it clear for players what kind of computer can run Java Edition smoothly. While older devices may still launch the game, they will struggle to deliver a good experience. This can lead to low frame rates, visual issues, long loading times, or performance that doesn’t match what players expect.

Updating the requirements also helps us keep improving Minecraft. Supporting hardware that no longer runs the game well can limit what we’re able to modernize behind the scenes. By setting clearer recommendations, we can focus on making Java Edition better for our players.

Will this stop me from playing?

Some players using older hardware may notice that their device is now listed below the minimum spec. This may include older graphics cards, some older integrated graphics options, and older Intel-based Mac devices.

These updated recommended system requirements won’t stop you from playing Minecraft: Java Edition today. If your computer falls below the new minimum requirements, Java Edition should still launch. However, its performance and visual quality are no longer guaranteed on below-spec hardware, and it may struggle or fail to launch Java Edition in the future – especially as we transition away from OpenGL and towards Vulkan. We will keep players informed of these changes, especially changes that will sunset hardware that previously supported Minecraft: Java Edition.

What should I do?

From July 21, check the [Java System Requirements page](https://www.minecraft.net/store/minecraft-java-bedrock-edition-pc?tabs=%7B%22details%22%3A1%7D) on Minecraft.net for the updated minimum and recommended specs. If you already play Java Edition without issues, you may not notice anything changing right away. If your game often struggles, the new requirements may help explain why and give you a clearer target for a smoother experience.

If you’re buying a new device or checking whether your current one is ready for Java Edition, use the new recommended specs as your best guide. They are designed around a stronger, steadier experience at 1080p and 60 FPS using the Fancy preset.

The recommended system requirements change on July 21

Performance and visual quality are no longer guaranteed on hardware below the new minimum

The updated minimum target is 1080p at 30 FPS on Fast settings

The updated recommended target is 1080p at 60 FPS on Fancy settings

有哪些变化呢？

之前的《Minecraft: Java版》系统要求是基于较旧的硬件和图形技术制定的。虽然这些规格在过去可能满足了游戏的需求，但现在已经无法满足游戏当前运行的要求了。

这就是为什么我们要提高 Minecraft: Java 版的最低系统要求和推荐系统要求的原因。新的要求包括更多的内存、更强大的处理器，以及支持 Vulkan 1.3 的图形硬件。

在最低系统要求方面，新的目标是使用“Fast”预设设置时能够实现 1080p 分辨率和 30 帧每秒的帧率。这意味着需要一台 64 位系统、8 GB 的 RAM（搭配独立显卡）或 12 GB 的 RAM（搭配集成显卡）、一个 4 核处理器，以及一个支持 Vulkan 1.3 且至少拥有 2 GB VRAM 的显卡。

在推荐系统要求方面，新的目标是使用“Fancy”预设设置时能够实现 1080p 分辨率和 60 帧每秒的帧率。这需要 16 GB 的 RAM、一个更先进的现代处理器，以及一块拥有 6 GB VRAM 的性能更强的显卡。

与许多现代的 AAA 级游戏相比，这些更新后的系统要求仍然相对较低。Java版不需要高端游戏电脑或最先进的显卡就能运行。新的系统要求只是为了更明确地界定当前环境下如何确保 Minecraft 的稳定体验，尤其是在 1080p 分辨率下。

我们为什么要更新这些系统要求？

我们的目标很简单：我们希望让玩家清楚地知道什么样的电脑能够流畅运行 Java版。虽然旧设备可能仍能启动游戏，但它们很难提供良好的游戏体验。这可能导致帧率低、视觉问题、加载时间长，或者游戏性能达不到玩家的预期。

更新系统要求也有助于我们不断改进《我的世界》。如果某些硬件不再能够流畅运行游戏，那么我们将无法对游戏进行现代化改造。通过设定更明确的建议，我们可以专注于让Java版为玩家提供更好的体验。

这会阻止我玩游戏吗？

一些使用老旧硬件的玩家可能会发现他们的设备被列入了最低配置要求清单之下。这些设备可能包括较旧的显卡、某些旧款集成显卡选项，以及基于Intel的旧款Mac设备。

这些更新的推荐系统要求并不会阻止您今天就开始玩《Minecraft: Java版》。即使您的计算机配置低于新的最低要求，Java版仍应该可以启动。但是，在配置较低的硬件上，游戏的性能和视觉效果将不再得到保障，未来游戏可能会出现运行困难或无法启动的情况——尤其是在我们逐步淘汰OpenGL、转向Vulkan技术的过程中。我们会及时通知玩家这些变化，特别是那些会导致 previously supported (先前支持) 的硬件不再兼容《Minecraft: Java版》的变化。

我该怎么办？

从7月21日起，请访问 Minecraft.net 上的[Java系统要求页面](https://www.minecraft.net/store/minecraft-java-bedrock-edition-pc?tabs=%7B%22details%22%3A1%7D)查看更新后的最低配置和推荐配置。如果您已经在使用Java版且没有遇到问题，可能不会立即感觉到任何变化；但如果游戏经常出现卡顿或延迟，新的系统要求或许能帮助您找出原因，并为您提供更清晰的改进方向，从而获得更加流畅的游戏体验。

如果您正在购买新设备，或者想确认当前设备是否适合运行Java版，请以新的推荐配置作为参考。这些配置旨在确保在1080p分辨率和60帧每秒的刷新率下，玩家能够获得更稳定、更顺畅的游戏体验（使用“Fancy”预设设置）。

新的推荐系统要求将于7月21日生效。

对于低于新最低配置要求的硬件设备，游戏性能和视觉效果将不再得到保证。

更新后的最低配置要求为：在“Fast”设置下，分辨率为1080p，帧率为30 FPS

更新后的推荐配置要求为：在“Fancy”设置下，分辨率为1080p，帧率为60 FPS
